notes: A cleaner Today screen: one summary card shows eaten, Cal left and your target, with macros underneath. Tap the target to change it for today.
One + button for adding food. It opens search, Estimate with Gemini and Help me pick from a menu, all in one place.
Meals now have their own icons, a total and a quick + to add to that meal. The Mon–Sun dots under the summary take you to Week.
New tab icons and simpler names: Today, Week, Journal, Foods, Settings. Text is easier to read, with no more all-caps labels.
Foods is a simple list: star your regulars and tap + to log one again. Week shows what's left, your daily average and a projected total.
maintenanceNote: Generated by scripts/prebuild.mjs from package.json and src/release-notes.json. Bump the 4-part "version" in package.json by hand (npm version cannot parse it), edit src/release-notes.json, then npm run build.
